comment: DauK is a Carminomycin 4-O-methyltransferase from Streptomyces sp. strain C5. It is a homologue of DnrK from S. peucetius. Both are involved in the biosynthetic pathway of the anthracycline daunorubicin.

changelog.comment: New entry. Removed 1 wrong source. Added RHOD to MRHO reaction.

reactions.description: DauK catalyzes the SAM-dependent 4-O-methylation of carminomycin to form daunorubicin.
DauK catalyzes the SAM-dependent 4-O-methylation of 13-dihydrocarminomycin to form 13-dihydrodaunorubicin.
DauK catalyzes the SAM-dependent 4-O-methylation of 13-deoxycarminomycin to form 13-deoxydaunorubicin.
DauK catalyzes the SAM-dependent 4-O-methylation of 10-carboxy-13-deoxycarminomycin to form 10-carboxy-13-deoxydaunorubicin.
DauK catalyzes the SAM-dependent 4-O-methylation of rhodomycin D to form 4-O-methylrhodomycin D.
